text: What was the danger to the villages after the fire?
zh: 火灾过后，村庄面临什么危险？
zh_hant: 火災過後，村莊面臨什麼危險？

text: Firemen had been fighting the forest fire for nearly three weeks
zh: 消防员们扑救森林大火已近三周
zh_hant: 消防員們撲救森林大火已近三週

text: before they could get it under control.
A short time before, great trees
had covered the countryside for miles around.
zh: 还覆盖着方圆数英里的乡村。
zh_hant: 還覆蓋著方圓數英里的鄉村。

text: Now, smoke still rose up from the warm ground
zh: 如今，温暖的地面上仍升起烟雾
zh_hant: 如今，溫暖的地面上仍升起煙霧

zh: 笼罩在荒凉的山丘之上。
zh_hant: 籠罩在荒涼的山丘之上。

text: Winter was coming on and the hills threatened the surrounding villages with destruction,
zh: 冬天即将来临，山丘威胁着周围村庄的存亡，
zh_hant: 冬天即將來臨，山丘威脅著周圍村莊的存亡，

text: for heavy rain would not only wash away the soil
zh: 因为大雨不仅会冲走土壤
zh_hant: 因為大雨不僅會沖走土壤

text: but would cause serious floods as well.
When the fire had at last been put out,
the forest authorities ordered several tons of a special type of grass-seed
zh: 林业部门订购了几吨特殊种类的草籽，
zh_hant: 林業部門訂購了幾噸特殊種類的草籽，

text: The seed was sprayed over the ground in huge quantities by aeroplanes.
zh: 飞机将这些草籽大量喷洒在地面上。
zh_hant: 飛機將這些草籽大量噴灑在地面上。

text: The planes had been planting seed for nearly a month when it began to rain.
zh: 飞机播种近一个月时，天开始下雨。
zh_hant: 飛機播種近一個月時，天開始下雨。

text: By then, however, in many places the grass had already taken root.
zh: 然而到那时，许多地方的草已经扎根了。
zh_hant: 然而到那時，許多地方的草已經紮根了。

text: In place of the great trees which had been growing there for centuries,
zh: 取代生长了几个世纪的大树，
zh_hant: 取代生長了幾個世紀的大樹，

text: patches of green had begun to appear in the blackened soil.
zh: 黑色土壤中开始出现一片片绿意。
zh_hant: 黑色土壤中開始出現一片片綠意。
